name: Circle wipe into wordmark, then the full promise and CTA
looks: A dark field opens into white through an expanding circle centred on the brand's mark. The mark and wordmark settle together over a soft multicolour aurora glow, and a short claim types in one word at a time beneath it, finishing with one word underlined in the accent colour, a button and a short domain pill landing last.
build: transitions.md's circle wipe (clip-path circle, power2.in) carries the cut from dark to white; aurora-gradient-photo for the glow behind the wordmark; list-stack-reveal's single-line variant for the claim typing in word by word, the key word gaining an underline on its own beat; the button and domain pill pop in with glass-ui-flow's small press-ready scale.
sound: A soft whoosh on the wipe, a confirm tone as the wordmark settles, a tick per word, and a light pop on the button and pill.
prompt: Close on the brand's core promise: wipe from a dark field into white through an expanding circle centred on the logo, settle the mark and name over a soft colourful glow, then type in a short, confident claim one word at a time with the key word underlined, landing on one button and a short domain as the call to action.
